establishes: Curvature over a metric family carrying SYMBOLIC PARAMETERS, so an identity that returns zero is zero AS A POLYNOMIAL -- true for every member of the family at once rather than at sampled fixtures. The family is g = L S L^T with L unit lower-triangular and S diagonal, both varying: LDL^T is the general symmetric matrix, so ten parameters span every independent component of a symmetric 4x4. FOUR STANDING LEDGER CLAIMS are upgraded from sampled to polynomial: Weyl tracelessness, both G1 coordinate-vector identities, G3 (the conformal weight of the Weyl tensor), and N1 (nabla^a B_ab = 0, the Noether/diffeomorphism identity of the Weyl action). N1 holds over a STRICTLY SMALLER sub-family than the other three -- see n1.
the_caveat_it_attacks: every curvature result in this stream is computed AT SPECIFIC METRICS -- a dozen exact rational fixtures, ranks taken over them. Strictly stronger than an unverified citation, strictly weaker than a theorem. 'Zero at twelve fixtures' is not 'zero for all metrics', and G1 in particular -- the coordinate vectors the entire D = 4 classification is expressed in -- rested on ONE metric.

how.the_observation: a jet already IS a truncated polynomial over its coefficient type, so the moment Jet<Rat> satisfies the Field vocabulary that Jet<T> demands of its coefficients, jets nest: Jet<Jet<Rat>>, outer variables the coordinates and inner the symbolic parameters. No new polynomial type and no second arithmetic to keep in step.
how.no_new_tensor_code: ci_lower_first, ci_ricci, ci_weyl, ci_raise_slot, ci_raise2, ci_dot and ci_trace_sq are used exactly as they are used on rationals, with T = Jet<Rat>. The contraction layer was already generic enough; it had simply never been handed anything but rationals. Taking the constant term in the COORDINATES first is what makes that work -- it leaves curvature at the base point, still polynomial in the parameters.
how.division_is_avoided_not_implemented: Field demands finv and a polynomial ring inverts only units. christoffel takes `half` as an argument and ci_weyl takes 1/(D-2); metric_inverse -- the one routine that divides -- is replaced by building g and g^{-1} directly from L and S. The two genuine inversions that remain, 1/s_k for the LDL^T diagonal and 1/Omega^2 for the conformal factor, are division BY UNITS: both have constant term +-1, so jet_inv returns an exact truncated inverse rather than trapping.
how.L_inverse_is_exact: L^{-1} = I - N + N^2 - N^3, since N^4 = 0 for a 4x4 strictly-lower matrix. An earlier draft used I - N, valid only when N^2 = 0 -- true for two non-chaining slots and WRONG for six, which chain through (2,1), (3,1), (3,2). The gate verifies g g^{-1} = I as a polynomial identity at every parameter count rather than trusting the series length.

truncation_is_a_check_not_a_caveat: the inner jet truncates, so a term above its degree is dropped SILENTLY -- and a dropped term is indistinguishable from one that was zero, which would turn 'the identity holds' into exactly the vacuous pass this programme keeps finding. The inner degree is DERIVED, not tuned: entries linear in the parameters give g^{-1} degree 6, Gamma degree 8, Riemann degree 16. Every row reports `unsat`, and the conclusions are void without it.

the_cost_and_two_wrong_predictions.measured: parameters 1..10, max terms in a Riemann coefficient 1 -> 15. Full sweep of six identities: 49.78 s, 109 MB.
the_cost_and_two_wrong_predictions.prediction_at_six_parameters: worst case C(22,6) = 74,613 monomials; actual 10. Wrong by four orders of magnitude.
the_cost_and_two_wrong_predictions.prediction_at_ten_parameters: worst case C(26,10) = 5,311,735; actual 15. Wrong by five.
the_cost_and_two_wrong_predictions.the_lesson: sparsity dominates worst-case counting here so completely that predicting the cost is not worth doing. Measure it -- and make the gate DEMAND the full family, so a prediction can never quietly become a cap. Had the six-parameter estimate been trusted, the sweep would have stopped at three and the ceiling would never have been found.

n1.what_it_is: nabla^a B_ab = 0 -- the gauge layer's own identity, the Noether/diffeomorphism content of the Weyl action.
n1.why_bach_of_could_not_deliver_it: bach_of returns Bach at a POINT because it is built on cv_cov_val, and a point cannot be differentiated. N1 needs Bach as a FUNCTION, so the chain was rebuilt with the jet-level covariant derivative throughout: nabla on C^a_{bcd} twice, contract to B_ab, raise, nabla once more, contract rho = e.
n1.the_certificate_predicted_the_wrong_bloc: this certificate previously recorded N1, N2 and the generator count as 'one job, not three -- the Euler operator over this ring'. That is correct for N2 and the generator count, which are about the VARIATION. It is WRONG for N1, which is about the TENSOR: nabla^a B_ab needs only the covariant derivative, which already existed. One of the three was not blocked at all, and grouping them hid that.
n1.only_the_constant_term_is_read_and_that_: each covariant derivative costs one valid outer order. From g at outer degree XDIV = 5: Riemann and C are trustworthy to 3, nabla nabla C to 1, nabla B to 0. Reading a higher order would be reading truncation garbage, so the constant term in the coordinates is the ONLY order read -- derived from the chain, not chosen for convenience. It is still a full polynomial in the PARAMETERS.
n1.a_control_named_in_advance_and_then_not_: SUPERSEDED -- it has now been built, and building it showed the advice was wrong. See the_einstein_control_was_built_and_is_nearly_vacuous.
n1.the_cost_ceiling_is_measured: three covariant derivatives mean rank-6 jet arrays at outer degree 5, and the cost climbs in the parameter count far faster than the undifferentiated identities do: twelve checks at the FULL ten parameters cost about 26 s, while N1 alone at three costs about 60 s. N1NP = 3 is A BUDGET, NOT A WALL, and the distinction is the point. np = 4 passes all four N1 conditions in 359 s and IS RECORDED AS VERIFIED; it is not the default only because it takes the gate from ~106 s to ~6 min, against this repository's own rule that a scoped rail routinely exceeding a minute should be split rather than normalised. np = 5 was NOT DETERMINED -- its run was killed to stop an out-of-proportion search, and a kill is neither a pass nor a fail. Elsewhere in this gate a PREDICTED cost nearly became a silent cap, which is why every other check demands the full family; the difference here is that the number is measured, the higher passing value is on the record, and the undetermined one is named as undetermined rather than implied to be a limit.
n1.the_search_for_the_ceiling_was_itself_di: an earlier attempt swept np = 2,3,4,5,6 and then 3,4,5,6,8,10 on a SHARED machine under load average 12-18, spending well over twenty minutes to locate an exact wall. The claim never depended on the ceiling being maximal, only on the printed number being TRUE, so the search was cut. Recorded because the failure is one of proportion rather than correctness, and that kind is the easiest to repeat. A second defect in the first sweep: the source was edited mid-sweep, so the later runs' sed no longer matched and they silently measured the OLD parameter count -- concurrent measurement and editing invalidate each other.

the_einstein_control_was_built_and_is_ne.what_was_advised: an earlier revision of this certificate said the Bach tensor should be checked to VANISH ON EINSTEIN METRICS 'before it can be believed', and the first N1 commit filed that as a debt. It is now built: Schwarzschild (M=1, r=4, x=cos theta=0) as a jet in the same nested ring with one unused dummy parameter, so the identical bach_of runs on it -- not a re-derivation that could agree by sharing a mistake. Ricci-flat, Weyl nonzero, Bach zero, and g.g^{-1} = I verified before anything is read.
the_einstein_control_was_built_and_is_ne.and_it_does_not_do_what_it_was_advertise: MUTATION TESTED with three separate defects introduced into bach_of. The Schwarzschild check PASSED ALL THREE: (1) the Ric.C coefficient changed from 1/2 to 1/3; (2) C_{acbd} contracted as C_{acdb}; (3) the two covariant-derivative indices swapped. It is not evidence that bach_of's coefficients are right.
the_einstein_control_was_built_and_is_ne.why_that_is_structural_and_should_have_b: on ANY Einstein metric R^{cd} C_{acbd} = (R/D) g^{cd} C_{acbd} = 0 by Weyl TRACELESSNESS, so the Ric.C term is multiplied by zero and its coefficient cannot be probed there at all. Schwarzschild is Ricci-flat, so more strongly: C = Riem and contractions of nabla nabla Riem vanish for reasons that survive getting the formula wrong. Bach-flatness on an Einstein metric is OVERDETERMINED -- many wrong formulas produce it. Naming a known-answer control in advance is good practice; it does not make the control discriminating, and this one was named without checking that it could fail.
the_einstein_control_was_built_and_is_ne.what_actually_constrains_bach_of: the CONFORMAL WEIGHT check caught mutations (1) and (2). That, not the Einstein metric, is the discriminating test, and it was already in the gate.
the_einstein_control_was_built_and_is_ne.what_the_control_is_kept_for: a genuine PIPELINE check: the whole chain runs on a metric from OUTSIDE the LDL^T family, with a real 1/r series rather than a polynomial, and returns the right answer. Narrower than advertised and still worth having, kept under an honest label rather than as a known-answer.
the_einstein_control_was_built_and_is_ne.one_mutation_is_undetermined: mutation (3), swapping the two covariant-derivative indices, was caught by NOTHING in the gate. nabla^c nabla^d and nabla^d nabla^c differ by a commutator, so either that difference vanishes under this contraction -- making the mutation a semantic no-op -- or the gate has an untested degree of freedom. WHICH ONE IS NOT DETERMINED. Guessing at a mechanism without a control that can refute it is exactly what produced the parity retraction, so it is recorded open.
